provenance.name: SPY Daily Bars with VIX and 10-Year Yield
provenance.license: Yahoo Finance terms of use — personal and research use
provenance.citation: Yahoo Finance (2026). Historical daily price data for SPY, ^VIX and ^TNX, 2015-01-01 to 2026-09-01. Retrieved via the yfinance library.
provenance.notes: Split- and dividend-adjusted daily closes. SPY is the S&P 500 ETF; ^VIX is implied volatility; ^TNX is the 10-year Treasury yield.

split.notes: Expanding window; every forecast is out-of-sample by construction.

models.name: Random walk (zero)
models.notes: Predicts no move; interval from trailing realised volatility.

models.name: Historical drift
models.notes: Predicts the trailing mean return; same volatility interval.

models.name: Empirical quantiles
models.notes: Trailing 500-day empirical quantiles; no distributional assumption.

models.name: Ridge + residual quantiles
models.notes: Scaler fitted per fold inside the pipeline; intervals from in-fold residuals.

models.name: LightGBM quantile
models.notes: Three boosters trained directly on the pinball objective.

models.name: EWMA vol + Student-t
models.notes: Zero drift; interval from EWMA volatility with t(4) quantiles for fat tails.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_no_lookahead
runtime_assertions.detail: 780 feature values across 30 dates recomputed on truncated history; 0 differed from the full-history value.

runtime_assertions.name: assert_no_target_leak
runtime_assertions.detail: 26 numeric features correlated against the target; strongest was ret_lag2 at |r|=0.0909 (threshold 0.995).
